# Redaction

Credentials never leave the SDK in readable form: not in error messages, hook data, logger output,
`toString`/debug/JSON forms of configs and secret values. Redaction replaces values with
`[REDACTED]`.

## Rules

- **Sensitive headers** (case-insensitive): `authorization`, `proxy-authorization`, `cookie`,
  `set-cookie`, and any name containing `token`, `secret`, `password`, `api-key`, `apikey`, `key`,
  `auth`, `session`, `signature` or `credential`.
- **Sensitive fields and query parameters** (case-insensitive substring): `password`, `passwd`,
  `secret`, `token`, `authorization`, `cookie`, `api_key`, `apikey`, `api-key`, `access_key`,
  `private_key`, `client_secret`, `credential`, `session`, `signature`.
- **Known secrets**: every error message passes through `redactText` with the secret values the
  client knows (token, passwords from the config, …); any occurrence of length ≥ 4 is replaced.
- Vendor error text is redacted and truncated to 300 characters.

## The `Secret` type

Credentials in configuration are wrapped in `Secret`. Its string, debug and JSON forms print
`[REDACTED]`; `reveal()` returns the value when you really need it.

=== "TypeScript"

    ```ts
    import { Secret } from "@grow-codes/zipkin";

    const token = new Secret("s3cr3t-value");
    String(token);         // "[REDACTED]"
    JSON.stringify(token); // "\"[REDACTED]\""
    token.reveal();        // "s3cr3t-value"
    ```

=== "Rust"

    ```rust
    use grow_zipkin::Secret;

    let token = Secret::new("s3cr3t-value");
    format!("{token:?}");  // "[REDACTED]"
    token.expose_secret(); // "s3cr3t-value" (also: reveal())
    // The memory is zeroized when the Secret is dropped.
    ```

=== "Go"

    ```go
    token := zipkin.NewSecret("s3cr3t-value")
    fmt.Sprint(token)        // "[REDACTED]"
    fmt.Sprintf("%#v", token) // "[REDACTED]"
    token.Reveal()           // "s3cr3t-value"
    // slog and encoding/json also see [REDACTED].
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    from grow_zipkin import Secret

    token = Secret("s3cr3t-value")
    str(token)               # "[REDACTED]"; repr() never shows the value either
    token.reveal()           # "s3cr3t-value"
    ```

=== "Java"

    ```java
    Secret token = Secret.of("s3cr3t-value".toCharArray());
    token.toString();   // "[REDACTED]"
    token.reveal();     // "s3cr3t-value"
    token.clear();      // wipes the char[] backing store
    ```

## Redaction helpers

The helpers are public so your own code (logs, hooks, error reports) can apply the same rules.

| Function | What it does |
| - | - |
| `redactHeaders(headers)` | copy with sensitive header values replaced |
| `redactUrl(url)` | URL with sensitive query values replaced (and user info removed) |
| `redactFields(map, extraKeys?)` | recursive copy of nested maps/lists with sensitive keys replaced |
| `redactText(text, knownSecrets)` | replaces every known secret value (length ≥ 4) |

=== "TypeScript"

    ```ts
    import { redactFields, redactHeaders, redactText, redactUrl } from "@grow-codes/zipkin";

    redactHeaders({ Authorization: "Bearer abc", Accept: "application/json" });
    // { authorization: "[REDACTED]", accept: "application/json" }
    redactUrl("https://api.example.com/v1?token=abc&page=2");
    // "https://api.example.com/v1?token=[REDACTED]&page=2"
    redactFields({ user: "ana", password: "x", nested: { apiKey: "y" } });
    redactText("login failed for s3cr3t-value", ["s3cr3t-value"]);
    // "login failed for [REDACTED]"
    ```

=== "Rust"

    ```rust
    use grow_zipkin::core::redact::{redact_fields, redact_headers, redact_text, redact_url};

    let headers = redact_headers([("Authorization", "Bearer abc"), ("Accept", "application/json")]);
    let url = redact_url("https://api.example.com/v1?token=abc&page=2");
    let fields = redact_fields(&serde_json::json!({"password": "x", "nested": {"apiKey": "y"}}), &[]);
    let text = redact_text("login failed for s3cr3t-value", &["s3cr3t-value"]);
    ```

=== "Go"

    ```go
    h := zipkin.RedactHeaderMap(map[string]string{"Authorization": "Bearer abc"})
    u := zipkin.RedactURL("https://api.example.com/v1?token=abc&page=2")
    f := zipkin.RedactFields(map[string]any{"password": "x", "nested": map[string]any{"apiKey": "y"}})
    t := zipkin.RedactText("login failed for s3cr3t-value", []string{"s3cr3t-value"})
    // RedactHeaders(http.Header) works on net/http headers.
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    from grow_zipkin import redact_fields, redact_headers, redact_text, redact_url

    redact_headers({"Authorization": "Bearer abc", "Accept": "application/json"})
    redact_url("https://api.example.com/v1?token=abc&page=2")
    redact_fields({"password": "x", "nested": {"apiKey": "y"}})
    redact_text("login failed for s3cr3t-value", ["s3cr3t-value"])
    ```

=== "Java"

    ```java
    import codes.grow.packages.zipkin.core.Redaction;

    Redaction.redactHeaders(Map.of("Authorization", "Bearer abc"));
    Redaction.redactUrl("https://api.example.com/v1?token=abc&page=2");
    Redaction.redactFields(Map.of("password", "x", "nested", Map.of("apiKey", "y")));
    Redaction.redactText("login failed for s3cr3t-value", List.of("s3cr3t-value"));
    ```

!!! tip "Logs"
    Do not log revealed secrets yourself: the SDK can only redact values it knows about.
